summary: std/x509: chain building counts every candidate toward the 100 signature check limit and stops at it, and policy validation prunes once per certificate, as Go 1.27.4 (GO-2026-4947, GO-2026-4946)
details: chain building counts every candidate toward the 100 signature check limit and stops at it, and policy validation prunes once per certificate, as Go 1.27.4 (GO-2026-4947, GO-2026-4946); a crafted intermediate pool can now end with `signature check attempts limit reached` where it was an unknown authority. Affected: 0.50.1 and earlier.
changelog: - Security (std/x509, native backends): chain building counts every candidate toward the 100 signature check limit and stops at it, and policy validation prunes once per certificate, as Go 1.27.4 (GO-2026-4947, GO-2026-4946); a crafted intermediate pool can now end with `signature check attempts limit reached` where it was an unknown authority. Affected: 0.50.1 and earlier.
